inclusions.text: Hotel pickup in an air-conditioned vehicle
inclusions.source: The evening begins with a hotel pickup in an air-conditioned vehicle; confirm your hotel address and a precise departure time when booking, as the cruise has a fixed boarding window.
The cruise concludes with a return transfer to your hotel.
Beverages are available; soft drinks are typically included, alcohol is an additional charge.

exclusions.source: Beverages are available; soft drinks are typically included, alcohol is an additional charge.
